verdict.rationale: Conductor's docs describe cloud workspaces as sandboxes that spin up in seconds, with agents that keep working after you close your laptop. Agents can test, run builds and edit setup scripts without per-step confirmation, and tasks can be delegated via the API, MCP server, schedules or GitHub actions. The older community comment describing local-only worktrees predates the cloud feature rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud background execution, and detail on the sandbox isolation model and limits for long-running tasks.
